name: kuka-virtual-validation
description: Compose and verify file-based robotics evidence through the isolated KUKA Validation Lab.

interface.shortDescription: Validate robotics artifacts with isolated KUKA Lab evidence.
interface.longDescription: Accepts raw SRC/DAT or an already-produced ValidationPackage through an isolated file boundary, verifies identities and static readiness, and can execute a hash-bound candidate in exact-C01 OfficeLite native KSS or KUKA.Sim. Native execution requires a current exact-profile receipt and restores the disposable clone snapshot; simulation captures joint/TCP evidence or an interpreter rejection. It also composes Stage-One evidence and verifies immutable receipts without invoking or changing Rhino.
capabilities: Exact-C01 OfficeLite native KSS candidate execution
defaultPrompt: Compose a Stage-One receipt for this robotics candidate.
Compare this ValidationPackage target with the verified controller observation.
Run and verify this hash-bound KRL candidate through exact-C01 native KSS and KUKA.Sim.
